acceptance: Each named generator writes through pyarrow.csv or DuckDB COPY, with no per-row Python write loop left.
For each generator at a small scale factor with a fixed seed, the generated files are byte-identical to the base commit's, or the difference is documented and the data-generation version bumped.
Before and after generation time recorded per generator at SF1.
description:
Scope left from perf-library-loaders-and-datagen-rows-20261031 (finished in PR #3952). That PR met the item's acceptance for the library loaders, but it reverted the data-generation part to stay under the hosted review size cap. Still to do: the staging rewrite in generator_base and the per-row csv.writer generators for SSB, AMPLab, TSBS and TPC-DI write files one Python row at a time. Use pyarrow.csv or DuckDB COPY instead.

The generated files must stay byte-identical for the same seed and scale factor, or a documented format change must be recorded in the changelog with a data-generation version bump. Re-read the symbols before editing, since line numbers drift.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree; no explanatory comments; changelog.d fragment; heavy runs only through make heavy-run; no live cloud.
